name: daily-standup-notes
description: Collect standup answers (yesterday / today / blockers) via form steps, then format a concise Markdown summary.

steps.description: What will you work on today?

inputs.name: blockers
inputs.description: Blockers or impediments (leave blank if none)

steps.description: Format the collected answers into a Markdown standup note.
steps.run:
set -o pipefail; jq -r '
  "## Standup — " + ((.inputs.team_name // "Team") | tostring) + "\n" +
  "**Yesterday:** " + ((."collect-yesterday".yesterday // "") | tostring) + "\n" +
  "**Today:** " + ((."collect-today".today // "") | tostring) + "\n" +
  if ((."collect-blockers".blockers // "") | tostring) != "" then
    "**Blockers:** " + ((."collect-blockers".blockers // "") | tostring)
  else
    "**Blockers:** None"
  end
' <<< "$OSL_CONTEXT" | jq -Rs '{summary: .}'
